exact.亮度 ∝ 该像元的夜间平均辐射（nW·cm⁻²·sr⁻¹）。黄色越亮，人类夜间活: Brightness ∝ the pixel's average nighttime radiance (nW·cm⁻²·sr⁻¹). The brighter the yellow, the denser human activity at night. But DNB does not record only city lights: gas flares, fishing fleets and wildfires show up too, and high-latitude summer twilight is suppressed in the composite — so a dark polar region is not empty of people, just of residual light the algorithm has removed. It measures how lit a place is at night, and should not be read as a population or GDP map.
